annotations.title: Do PWA requirements apply to this project?

description: Says whether a project must meet the prevailing wage and apprenticeship requirements to claim the increased (5x) credit, and which ones: the credit involved, when construction began (before January 29, 2023 is exempt for 30C, 45, 45Q, 45V, 45Y, 48, 48E and 179D; 45L, 45U, 45Z and 48C have no such exception), the one-megawatt exception for 45, 45Y, 48 and 48E (maximum net output under 1 MW AC by nameplate, aggregated across the energy project or across facilities with integrated operations; for DC generation the lesser of the DC nameplate sum or the first inverter), construction versus alteration or repair after placed in service (apprenticeship applies to construction only; prevailing wages continue 5 years for the ITC, 10 for the PTC), the applicable apprentice percentage (10 / 12.5 / 15%), whether the project is under section 48 or 48E, and for solar and wind the 2025 law’s termination dates (construction after July 4, 2026 must be placed in service by December 31, 2027).

construction_began.description: When construction began (YYYY-MM-DD), under the IRS beginning-of-construction rules (physical work test or 5% safe harbor).

credit.description: The Code section claimed: 48 (energy credit), 48E (clean electricity investment credit), 45, 45Y, 45Q, 45V, 45Z, 45U, 45L, 179D, 30C or 48C.

dwelling_type.description: For 45L only: the kind of home (prevailing wage reaches only multifamily units).

max_net_output_mw_ac.description: Maximum net output in megawatts AC by nameplate, AGGREGATED: for section 48 the sum of every energy property in the energy project (1.48-13(e)(1)); for 48E and 45Y the sum of every same-technology facility or storage with integrated operations (same or related owner, same taxable year placed in service, same point of interconnection or end user: 1.48E-3(c)(4), 1.45Y-3(c)(3)). Leave out if not an electricity or thermal project.

placed_in_service.description: Placed-in-service date (YYYY-MM-DD), if known or planned.

technology.description: What the facility is: solar or wind (the 2025 law’s termination dates apply), storage, or other.

work_type.description: construction (default) or alteration_or_repair after the facility is placed in service.
